label: Mainstream erotic / R-rated research

Every record has at least one verified free legal watch link (Tubi, Pluto TV, The Roku Channel or Xumo Play) in sources/watch-links.json. Plot sub-groups: murder mystery / femme fatale, obsession / stalker, affair / infidelity, erotic drama / romance, erotic horror / fantasy.
